segment.source: Review task status, deployment health, and recent automation activity in one custom container.
segment.target: Revise o status das tarefas, a integridade das implantações e as atividades recentes de automação em um contêiner personalizado.

segment.source: BorderBeam can decorate any Avalonia container. When the content does not implement IBorderBeamAwareControl, set matching BorderThickness and CornerRadius on BorderBeam.
segment.target: BorderBeam pode decorar qualquer contêiner Avalonia. Quando o conteúdo não implementar IBorderBeamAwareControl, defina BorderThickness e CornerRadius correspondentes no BorderBeam.

segment.source: Custom container
segment.target: Contêiner personalizado

segment.source: Stop positions use the public 0-100 input range.
segment.target: As posições das paradas usam o intervalo público de entrada de 0 a 100.

segment.source: Display six gradient beam palettes and switch between them.
segment.target: Exiba seis paletas de gradiente do feixe e alterne entre elas.

segment.target: Customized cor

segment.source: The original pacing for most emphasized containers.

segment.source: Use Duration to control how long the beam takes to complete one loop. The default is 6 seconds.
segment.target: Use Duration para controlar quanto tempo o feixe leva para completar um ciclo. O padrão é 6 segundos.

segment.source: A quick loop for temporary highlights and active modules.

segment.source: Use BorderThickness to adjust the beam width. Its default value follows the shared border thickness token.
segment.target: Use BorderThickness para ajustar a espessura do feixe. O valor padrão segue o token compartilhado de espessura da borda.

segment.source: Line width
segment.target: Espessura da linha

segment.source: Set Count to distribute multiple beams evenly around the container border.
segment.target: Defina Count para distribuir vários feixes uniformemente ao redor da borda do contêiner.

segment.source: Multiple beams
segment.target: Vários feixes

segment.source: Use Count to distribute multiple beams evenly along one container boundary.
segment.target: Use Count para distribuir vários feixes uniformemente ao longo da borda de um contêiner.

segment.source: Multiple beams
segment.target: Vários feixes

segment.source: The top corners keep a larger radius while the bottom corners remain square.
segment.target: O superior corners keep a larger raio while o inferior corners remain quadrado.

segment.source: Set Outset to 0 when the decorated container clips its own corners.
segment.target: Definir Outset para 0 quando o decorated container clips its own corners.

segment.target: Non-uniform raio

segment.source: BorderBeam wraps a content control and renders a non-interactive beam on its border. It is decorative, stays active independently of the global motion setting by default, and can use a solid color or gradient stops.
segment.target: BorderBeam wraps a conteúdo controle e renders a non-interactive beam em its borda. Isso é decorative, stays active independently de o global motion configuração por padrão, e pode usar a solid cor ou gradient stops.
